name: s3Read
syntax: s3Read(bucketName, objectName [, charset, accessKeyId, secretAccessKey, host, timeout])
description: Reads an object from an S3 bucket as a string.

params.name: accessKeyId
params.description: The S3 access key ID. Defaults to the `lucee.s3.accesskeyid` system property or environment variable.

params.name: secretAccessKey
params.description: The S3 secret access key. Defaults to the `lucee.s3.secretaccesskey` system property or environment variable.

params.name: host
params.description: The hostname of an S3-compatible provider, without `https://`. Defaults to Amazon AWS.

rustcfml.notes: Names the first two arguments `bucket` and `object`, and the secret key argument `secretKey`. Doesn't list `timeout`.

examples.title: Read an object into a string
examples.description: Reads the body of an object from a bucket.
